entries.t: Diagnosing from monitoring data · Reading the numbers

entries.ko: 평균은 정상인데 렉이 나는 이유: 백분위 읽기
1초에 20번 잰 지연 값을 1분 동안 모았습니다. 서버 틱 시간이나 유저의 핑이라고 생각하면 됩니다. 가끔 튀는 값은 평균과 긴 간격의 평균 그래프에서는 거의 보이지 않지만 p99와 최댓값에는 그대로 드러납니다.
entries.t: Latency measured 20 times a second, collected over 1 minute. Think of it as server tick time or a player’s ping. Occasional spikes almost vanish in the average and in graphs averaged over long intervals, but they show up in full in p99 and the maximum.

entries.ko: 튀는 비율을 1%에 두고 평균과 p99를 비교해 보세요. 평균은 평소와 비슷한데 p99는 튄 값 근처입니다.
entries.t: Keep Spike rate at 1% and compare the average with p99. The average stays close to normal, while p99 sits near the spike values.

entries.ko: 집계 간격을 60초로 바꿔 보세요. 굵은 평균선이 평평해져서 그래프만 보면 아무 일도 없어 보입니다.
entries.t: Change Aggregation interval to 60 seconds. The thick average line goes flat, and from the graph alone, nothing seems to have happened.

entries.ko: 튀는 비율을 0으로 내리면 평균·p50·p99가 모두 가까워집니다. 튐이 없을 때만 평균이 믿을 만합니다.
entries.t: Lower Spike rate to 0, and the average, p50, and p99 all come together. The average is trustworthy only when there are no spikes.

entries.ko: 튀는 비율을 5%로 올려 보세요. 이제 평균도 오르지만 여전히 튄 값보다 훨씬 낮게 보입니다.
entries.t: Raise Spike rate to 5%. Now the average goes up too, but it still looks far lower than the spikes.

entries.ko: 잰 값집계 간격 평균
entries.t: Measured valuesInterval average

entries.t: {0}With no spikes, the average {1}, p50 {2}, and p99 {3} are all close. Only in this case is the average alone enough to judge by.

entries.t: {0}The average is {1}, only a little above normal ({2} ms), but p99 is {3} and the max is {4}. If {5}% of 20 measurements per second spike, there’s a hitch {6}, and players remember those moments as lag. On the {7} s average line (the thick line), each spike is blended with {8} values, so it {9}.

stale.t: The average looks fine, so why do players call it lag?
